subject.title: feat(telegram): send voice typing cue before transcription

question: Should this visible Telegram typing-cue change require live Telegram proof before merge, or can maintainers intentionally accept the source-ordering evidence?
rationale: The code and focused tests support the ordering change, but repository policy and the Telegram scoped guide require real Telegram proof for transport-visible behavior, and the current proof is mock/test output only.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer proof lane captures redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence on the current head.

options.title: Accept source-ordering risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge after conflicts are resolved using focused source tests only, while owning the risk that Telegram clients still do not visibly show the cue soon enough.

options.title: Pause or replace later
options.body: If proof and conflict resolution remain unavailable, leave the linked issue open and revisit with a fresh or replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer proof lane captures redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent high-confidence history around the Telegram context/body and sendChatAction-adjacent surfaces involved in this proof decision.
